detail.what: path row: the moves, applied to the start built from the dataset relators and the row's z word(s), end with every relator one letter and the letters the n generators up to inverse
path row: no relator longer than 24 at any state of the replay, start included
row of a rank-3 / relsub jsonl (path rows and sample / relsub rows): r1 and r2 equal the dataset relators of its pres_id
path row: len(path_moves) == path_length of the sample / relsub row with the same pres_id + z_word, and that row is solved
path row: len(path_moves) == npz path_len[row of pres_id, word_index] (rank n: [row of pres_id, index])
nodes_explored of the jsonl row == npz nodes cell (rank 3: every sample row; rank n: every path row)
every sample / relsub row with solved true has a path row
extra. path row: every move is one the search can emit: 0 <= k1 < len(r_i), 0 <= k2 < len(r_j), both relators non-empty, the seam cancels
extra. rank-3 sample row: path_length (null -> -1) == npz path_len cell, and solved <=> cell >= 0
extra. rank-3 sample row: npz words[word_index] == z_word
extra. rank-n path row: rank == 2 + len(z_words) == r<R> of the file name == npz meta rank, and z_words == [words[c] for c in combos[index]]
extra. rank-3 / relsub row: name is ms640_<pres_id>, z_word is a word in x,y (of length L and freely reduced in an L file), z_relator == 'Z' + z_word
every jsonl line is a JSON object; no two sample / relsub rows share pres_id + z_word with different solved / nodes / path_length
a path file that is present has at least one row
when one file of a (paths, rows, npz) group is present, the others are too
